note: Temporary defaults for pipeline smoke and audit-package generation only. Not Frozen Config. Not optimal. Not calibrated against Human Boundary GT.

motion_speed_threshold.note: Reuses G1-P1 exploratory visualization default. Applied to smoothed_translation_speed. Not a frozen moving/stationary definition.

motion_persistence_frames.note: 0.20s at 20 Hz. Both pre-change and post-change regimes must persist. Filters isolated speed spikes.

direction_change_threshold.note: Large heading-change evidence (~69 deg). Consumes G1-P1 windowed 3D direction_change_evidence; does not recompute it.

direction_persistence_frames.note: Persistent high direction evidence required. Single-frame sign flips are not candidates.

gripper_state_threshold.note: Smoke-init split between fully-open ~0.08 and in-hand/hold ~0.04. NOT a calibrated OPEN/CLOSED physical definition. NOT grasp success.

gripper_persistence_frames.note: Persistent open/close regime on both sides of the crossing. Instantaneous aperture flicker is not a Hard Boundary.

debounce_frames.note: Suppresses repeated same-type same-polarity candidates. Opposite gripper transitions are NOT debounced into one event.

boundary_consolidation_window.note: Nearby Hard+Motion candidates may share one physical transition. Opposite Hard Boundaries are never merged.

pause_bridge_duration.note: 0.50s at 20 Hz. Short idle may be bridged only with compatible gripper and heading and no Hard Boundary.

min_segment_length.note: Triggers SHORT_SEGMENT_CANDIDATE review/merge. Does not delete. Hard Boundaries are protected.

max_segment_length.note: Audit flag only. No equal-window forced split in G1-P2.

boundary_tolerance_window.note: Schema reserved for G1-P3 Human Boundary matching. Not used by the G1-P2 segmenter.

rotation_support_threshold.note: Supporting evidence only. Rotation alone never creates a boundary.

action_support_threshold.note: Supporting evidence only. Action spike alone never creates a boundary.

support_window_frames.note: Window used to attach ROTATION_SUPPORT / ACTION_SUPPORT onto existing Motion candidates.

direction_compatibility_threshold.note: Pause-bridging heading compatibility. Not a frozen direction rule.

direction_window_frames.note: Heading window for pause-bridge compatibility using existing delta_xyz. Does not recompute G1-P1 direction_change_evidence.

direction_min_window_displacement_m.note: Minimum window displacement before pause-bridge heading is treated as defined.

smoke.selection_rule: Reuse G1-P1 smoke demos plus at least one WORSE demo under the length cap. Do not materialize the full 300-episode set.
